rule_descriptions.F_HOST_RECEIPT_GATE: Four required F-host receipts remain mandatory before final-ready or business-row promotion.
rule_descriptions.SINGLE_RUNNER_GATE: No second runner/task/takeover while canonical recovery is unresolved.
rule_descriptions.SOURCE_SEQUENCE_GATE: Source IDs remain contiguous and unique.
rule_descriptions.OPERATION_SEQUENCE_GATE: Operation IDs remain contiguous and unique.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_OS_MAPPING_BASIS: OS mapping basis and plan scale do not create an exact legal boundary.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_PLAN_QUALITY: Application-plan preparation requirements are planimetric/legal controls.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_SURVEY_SPEC: Registry surveying specification is separate from LiDAR vertical accuracy.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_CURRENT_GUIDE: Current guide version is freshness/routing evidence only.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_DETERMINED_MM: Determined-boundary ±10 mm measurement rule is horizontal/legal, not vertical terrain error.
rule_descriptions.OS_T5_PRODUCT: Terrain 5 is a 5 m DTM secondary cross-check.
rule_descriptions.OS_T5_CRS: Terrain 5 GML uses EPSG:27700 BNG geometry semantics.
rule_descriptions.OS_T5_UPDATE: Terrain 5 update programme is product currency, not parcel acquisition time.
rule_descriptions.OS_T5_TIDAL_STEP: Tile-average tidal modelling can introduce small adjacent-tile steps.
rule_descriptions.OS_T5_SOURCE_TIN: Terrain 5 grid/contours are interpolated from a source TIN.
rule_descriptions.OS_T5_BARE_EARTH: Terrain 5 source modelling removes buildings, supported structures and vegetation.
rule_descriptions.OS_T5_SOURCE_RMSE: OS source positional RMSE is distinct from EA LiDAR survey RMSE.
rule_descriptions.OS_T5_TILE_METADATA: Per-tile metadata carries version and lineage/change information.
rule_descriptions.OS_T5_SUPPLY: Quarterly full-tile resupply is distribution evidence.
rule_descriptions.OS_T5_ASCII_GML: GML metadata plus external ASCII grid is an encoding structure, not independent measurement evidence.
rule_descriptions.OGC_MAP_PORTRAYAL: OGC API Maps is portrayal/retrieval, not native numeric sampling.
rule_descriptions.OGC_TILE_DERIVED: Coverage tiles may be subset/resampled and are derived delivery unless native semantics are proved.
rule_descriptions.EA_DTM_PRIMARY: EA DTM1m remains the primary bare-earth terrain source.
rule_descriptions.EA_METADATA_INDEX_REQUIRED: Parcel-specific survey lineage remains unknown without an exact EA metadata-index feature match.
rule_descriptions.NUMERIC_PRESERVATION: Existing measured 1m/2m values stay unchanged during QA.
rule_descriptions.RESULT_CONFIDENCE_ROLE: 96% is repository workflow confidence, not universal statistical confidence.
rule_descriptions.BUSINESS_ROW_GUARD: Business rows remain zero until recovery acceptance.
rule_descriptions.FINAL_READY_GUARD: final_ready remains false while F-host receipts are absent.
rule_descriptions.WEB_OVERLAY_ROLE: Repo web overlay visibility is not live port-8012 acceptance.
rule_descriptions.MAIN_MANIFEST_CONCURRENCY: Shared main manifest is not rewritten under concurrent slot activity.
